protocol72.title: The 72-Hour Protocol
protocol72.description: Derived from the Exxon Valdez failure. The standard response window for energy sector crises in Latin America — with local adaptations.
protocol72.row1_action: Notify CEO · Activate spokesperson · Issue holding statement
protocol72.row1_latam: Statement in Spanish/Portuguese first · Alert community leaders directly
protocol72.row2_action: CEO on camera with empathy statement
protocol72.row2_latam: Local-language video via WhatsApp before national media
protocol72.row3_action: First full briefing · Establish twice-daily cadence
protocol72.row3_latam: Brief government ministries before press conference
protocol72.row4_latam: Engage local university or NGO as monitor — not company-selected
protocol72.row5_latam: CEO meets affected community in their space, not yours

fpic.title: FPIC / Consulta Previa Checklist
fpic.description: Derived from Cases L1, L2, L3. For any energy operations in or near indigenous territories in Latin America.
fpic.item1: Community baseline study conducted and published?
fpic.item2: Consulta previa process initiated at least 12 months before operations?
fpic.item3: Affected communities represented by their own chosen representatives?
fpic.item4: Company publicly committed to genuine consent (not just notification)?
fpic.item5: Community-governed benefit fund with independent oversight established?
fpic.item6: Environmental monitoring results published in the community's language?

antiCorruption.title: Anti-Corruption Market Entry Checklist
antiCorruption.description: Derived from Cases 07, L2, L3. FCPA and local compliance requirements for LatAm energy market entry.
antiCorruption.item1: FCPA risk assessment completed for all planned jurisdictions?
antiCorruption.item2: Enhanced due diligence on all local agents, intermediaries, and consultants?
antiCorruption.item3: Anti-corruption warranties in all contracts with audit rights?
antiCorruption.item4: State energy partner corruption exposure assessed?
antiCorruption.item5: Internal anti-corruption reporting channel established and communicated?
antiCorruption.item6: Third-party anti-corruption audit programme publicly disclosed?
antiCorruption.item7: Multi-jurisdictional legal counsel engaged for coordinated regulatory response?
